name: Cylinder (cong)
dimensions: Height 3 cm; Width 5.4 cm; Thickness 2.9 cm
summary: A 'cong' is a jade tube that is square on the outside with a round perforation in the middle. An ancient Chinese text entitled ' Zhouli' ('Rituals of Zho'u) describes the 'cong' as a ceremonial object to sacrifice to Earth.
